chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Set up and operate equipment that mixes or blends ingredients used in the manufacturing of food products. Includes candy makers and cheese makers.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Record production and test data for each food product batch, such as the ingredients used, temperature, test results, and time cycle.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Clean and sterilize vats and factory processing areas.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Set up, operate, and tend equipment that cooks, mixes, blends, or processes ingredients in the manufacturing of food products, according to formulas or recipes.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Mix or blend ingredients, according to recipes, using a paddle or an agitator, or by controlling vats that heat and mix ingredients.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Follow recipes to produce food products of specified flavor, texture, clarity, bouquet, or color.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Give directions to other workers who are assisting in the batchmaking process.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Select and measure or weigh ingredients, using English or metric measures and balance scales.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Press switches and turn knobs to start, adjust, and regulate equipment, such as beaters, extruders, discharge pipes, and salt pumps.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Determine mixing sequences, based on knowledge of temperature effects and of the solubility of specific ingredients.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Observe and listen to equipment to detect possible malfunctions, such as leaks or plugging, and report malfunctions or undesirable tastes to supervisors.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Observe gauges and thermometers to determine if the mixing chamber temperature is within specified limits, and turn valves to control the temperature.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Turn valve controls to start equipment and to adjust operation to maintain product quality.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Modify cooking and forming operations based on the results of sampling processes, adjusting time cycles and ingredients to achieve desired qualities, such as firmness or texture.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Examine, feel, and taste product samples during production to evaluate quality, color, texture, flavor, and bouquet, and document the results.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Test food product samples for moisture content, acidity level, specific gravity, or butter-fat content, and continue processing until desired levels are reached.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Inspect vats after cleaning to ensure that fermentable residue has been removed.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Fill processing or cooking containers, such as kettles, rotating cookers, pressure cookers, or vats, with ingredients, by opening valves, by starting pumps or injectors, or by hand.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Manipulate products, by hand or using machines, to separate, spread, knead, spin, cast, cut, pull, or roll products.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers
chunks.text: Place products on carts or conveyors to transfer them to the next stage of processing.

chunks.text: Homogenize or pasteurize material to prevent separation or to obtain prescribed butterfat content, using a homogenizing device.

chunks.title: Food Batchmakers

chunks.title: Tool and Die Makers
chunks.text: Analyze specifications, lay out metal stock, set up and operate machine tools, and fit and assemble parts to make and repair dies, cutting tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and machinists' hand tools.

chunks.title: Tool and Die Makers
chunks.text: Verify dimensions, alignments, and clearances of finished parts for conformance to specifications, using measuring instruments such as calipers, gauge blocks, micrometers, or dial indicators.

chunks.title: Tool and Die Makers
chunks.text: Set up and operate conventional or computer numerically controlled machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, or grinders to cut, bore, grind, or otherwise shape parts to prescribed dimensions and finishes.

chunks.title: Tool and Die Makers

chunks.title: Tool and Die Makers

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Operate or control nuclear reactors. Move control rods, start and stop equipment, monitor and adjust controls, and record data in logs. Implement emergency procedures when needed. May respond to abnormalities, determine cause, and recommend corrective action.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Operate nuclear power reactors in accordance with policies and procedures to protect workers from radiation and to ensure environmental safety.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Adjust controls to position rod and to regulate flux level, reactor period, coolant temperature, or rate of power flow, following standard procedures.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Develop or implement actions such as lockouts, tagouts, or clearances to allow equipment to be safely repaired.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Respond to system or unit abnormalities, diagnosing the cause, and recommending or taking corrective action.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Monitor all systems for normal running conditions, performing activities such as checking gauges to assess output or the effects of generator loading on other equipment.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Monitor or operate boilers, turbines, wells, or auxiliary power plant equipment.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Record operating data, such as the results of surveillance tests.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Implement operational procedures, such as those controlling start-up or shut-down activities.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Note malfunctions of equipment, instruments, or controls and report these conditions to supervisors.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators

chunks.text: Conduct inspections or operations outside of control rooms as necessary.

chunks.text: Supervise technicians' work activities to ensure that equipment is operated in accordance with policies and procedures that protect workers from radiation and ensure environmental safety.

chunks.title: Nuclear Power Reactor Operators
chunks.text: Authorize actions to correct identified operational inefficiencies or hazards so that operating efficiency is maximized and potential environmental issues are minimized.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Engrave or etch metal, wood, rubber, or other materials. Includes such workers as etcher-circuit processors, pantograph engravers, and silk screen etchers.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Inspect etched work for depth of etching, uniformity, and defects, using calibrated microscopes, gauges, fingers, or magnifying lenses.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Examine sketches, diagrams, samples, blueprints, or photographs to decide how designs are to be etched, cut, or engraved onto workpieces.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Prepare workpieces for etching or engraving by cutting, sanding, cleaning, polishing, or treating them with wax, acid resist, lime, etching powder, or light-sensitive enamel.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Engrave and print patterns, designs, etchings, trademarks, or lettering onto flat or curved surfaces of a wide variety of metal, glass, plastic, or paper items, using hand tools or hand-held power tools.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Prepare etching chemicals according to formulas, diluting acid with water to obtain solutions of specified concentration.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers

chunks.text: Measure and compute dimensions of lettering, designs, or patterns to be engraved.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Neutralize workpieces to remove acid, wax, or enamel, using water, solvents, brushes, or specialized machines.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Examine engraving for quality of cut, burrs, rough spots, and irregular or incomplete engraving.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Transfer image to workpiece, using contact printer, pantograph stylus, silkscreen printing device, or stamp pad.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Set reduction scales to attain specified sizes of reproduction on workpieces, and set pantograph controls for required heights, depths, and widths of cuts.

chunks.title: Etchers and Engravers
chunks.text: Print proofs or examine designs to verify accuracy of engraving, and rework engraving as required.

chunks.text: Start machines and lower cutting tools to beginning points on patterns.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Build semi-raw rubber treads onto buffed tire casings to prepare tires for vulcanization in recapping or retreading processes.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Trim excess rubber and imperfections during retreading processes.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Fill cuts and holes in tires, using hot rubber.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Place tires into molds for new tread.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Fit inner tubes and final layers of rubber onto tires.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Buff tires according to specifications for width and undertread depth.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Brush or spray solvents onto plies to ensure adhesion, and repeat process as specified, alternating direction of each ply to strengthen tires.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Start rollers that bond tread and plies as drums revolve.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Align treads with guides, start drums to wind treads onto plies, and slice ends.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Inspect worn tires for faults, cracks, cuts, and nail holes, and to determine if tires are suitable for retreading.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Measure tires to determine mold size requirements.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Roll hand rollers over rebuilt casings, exerting pressure to ensure adhesion between camelbacks and casings.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Position ply stitcher rollers and drums according to width of stock, using hand tools and gauges.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Cut plies at splice points, and press ends together to form continuous bands.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Depress pedals to rotate drums, and wind specified numbers of plies around drums to form tire bodies.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Rub cement sticks on drum edges to provide adhesive surfaces for plies.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Depress pedals to collapse drums after processing is complete.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Wind chafers and breakers onto plies.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Pull plies from supply racks, and align plies with edges of drums.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Inspect items for damage or defects.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Fill cracks, imperfections, or holes in products or workpieces.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

chunks.title: Tire Builders
chunks.text: Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Help production workers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Operate machinery used in the production process, or assist machine operators.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Place products in equipment or on work surfaces for further processing, inspecting, or wrapping.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Examine products to verify conformance to quality standards.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Start machines or equipment to begin production processes.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Observe equipment operations so that malfunctions can be detected, and notify operators of any malfunctions.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Remove products, machine attachments, or waste material from machines.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Lift raw materials, finished products, and packed items, manually or using hoists.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Transfer finished products, raw materials, tools, or equipment between storage and work areas of plants and warehouses, by hand or using hand trucks or powered lift trucks.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Pack and store materials and products.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Help production workers by performing duties of lesser skill, such as supplying or holding materials or tools, or cleaning work areas and equipment.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Count finished products to determine if product orders are complete.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Measure amounts of products, lengths of extruded articles, or weights of filled containers to ensure conformance to specifications.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Separate products according to weight, grade, size, or composition of materials used to produce them.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Turn valves to regulate flow of liquids or air, to reverse machines, to start pumps, or to regulate equipment.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Mark or tag identification on parts.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Mix ingredients according to specified procedures or formulas.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Record information, such as the number of products tested, meter readings, or dates and times of product production.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Read gauges or charts, and record data obtained.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Unclamp and hoist full reels from braiding, winding, or other fabricating machines, using power hoists.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Signal coworkers to direct them to move products during the production process.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Position spouts or chutes of storage bins so that containers can be filled.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Package products for storage or shipment.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Signal others to coordinate work activities.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.

chunks.title: Helpers--Production Workers
chunks.text: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
